description: Save the workflow the Workflow Agent proposed in one of its replies. Without `workflow` it is saved as a new private workflow. With `workflow` (the workflow that was attached when the agent was asked to edit it) the proposal replaces that workflow's steps, title and description; its saved input values and hidden secret inputs are kept. Applying needs the attached workflow's `loaded_updatetime`, and without `confirm: true` it only returns what would change: show that to the user and repeat the call with `confirm: true` after they agree. The reply is read again from Wiro, so pass its ids, not the JSON. Wiro checks and prepares the graph against the live model catalog first; if it finds problems, send them back to the Workflow Agent in the same session. Save each proposal once; saving it again can create another copy. Saving is free; running the workflow is charged.

acknowledge_review_reset.description: Required to change a published workflow, after the user agreed it leaves the gallery until reviewed.

artifact_hash.description: Which proposal to save when the reply has more than one (from send_agent_message or get_agent_message).

confirm.description: Required to apply a proposal to an existing workflow, after the user approved the change summary.

force.description: When applying: overwrite a newer version. Only when the user explicitly wants that.

loaded_updatetime.description: Required with `workflow`: the attached workflow's `updatetime` from send_agent_message or get_agent_message. Stops the save if someone changed the workflow since.

message_id.description: The message id from send_agent_message or get_agent_message. One id covers the message and its reply.

session.description: The session that reply belongs to.

workflow.description: Full slug or URL of the workflow to apply the proposal to. Leave it out to save a new workflow.

name: save_workflow_from_agent

stepChanges.description: What changed inside each step of stepsChanged. Input values are JSON text with object keys sorted and secrets hidden; null means not set. A long value is cut around the first place where the old and new value differ, with ... where text is left out.

discarded.description: With unchanged: Start field changes Wiro does not keep, because it saves Start fields the way the wiro.ai editor writes them.

required.description: Whether a run must be given this input, as far as Wiro says. Left out when that is not known.

title: Save a workflow from the Workflow Agent
